english.title: Conspire to produce a controlled drug of Class B - Other
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

to produce

(E)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(F)_[a quantity]_

of **(..SPECIFY DRUG NOT LISTED IN NOTE (ii) BELOW..), a controlled drug of class B in contravention of section 4(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
conspired together with other(s)
to produce a controlled drug of class 'B'

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Di-hydrocodeine is a class B drug when in injection form, when in tablet form it is a prescription controlled drug under the Medicines Act 1968 and not deemed a classified drug for the purposes of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971.
(ii) This offence wording should only be used for class 'B' drugs other than amphetamine.
